messages.text: BL-1983 🎵 in progress — The unit work ratchet does not refuse a run measured under host load: at a 5-minute load average at or above half the logical cores it prints its work line marked unmeasured and exits 0, and every duration record carries its load - QA's BL-1958 gather read 613108 ms with all 1161 tests green at load ~15, 391647 ms 24 minutes later
